name: @codelock/desktop

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && vite build && node scripts/write-defaults.mjs
scripts.dev: npm run build && cross-env CODELOCK_WEB_URL=http://localhost:3000 electron .
scripts.dist: npm run icon && npm run build && electron-builder --publish never
scripts.dist:all: npm run icon && npm run build && electron-builder -mwl --publish never

description: Solve a programming problem to unlock your device
